### Come and Be
Author: Mike DeVries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/come-and-be-homeword-april-4.html
Passage: Exodus 24:12
Points:
- God called Moses up the mountain not merely to receive stone tablets, but to dwell in His presence.
- The instruction to "stay here" calls believers to be fully alive, awake, and attentive to God in the moment.
- Moving at a breathless pace tempts people to focus on the next destination and overlook where God is right now.
- Walking closely with God begins with asking Him to awaken our hearts to His ongoing work in our daily lives.

### Doing Time
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-june-28-2011.html
Passage: Exodus 24:12-18
Points:
- God revealed His truth to Moses in written form so His people would know His mind and follow Him.
- Ascending the mountain to meet with the Lord requires deliberate spiritual discipline and personal preparation.
- Believers often understand spiritual disciplines in theory but become lethargic when it comes to practicing regular fellowship with God.
- Setting aside a daily time of communion strengthens Christians, regardless of the setting or duration, because God simply desires our heart.
